name: charter
description: A charter grants powers and limits them in the same document. Turns a two-minute interview into a project's working agreement and its enforced permission boundaries, then stays out of the way at about 600 tokens a session.

git.title: Default git autonomy
git.description: Pre-selected answer for new repositories. propose-only | local-commits | full. Force-push is denied in all three.

scope.title: Where boundaries are written
scope.description: auto | project | local. auto picks .claude/settings.json for team repos and .claude/settings.local.json for solo ones.

guidance.title: How much Charter explains itself
guidance.description: quiet | explain. quiet states an assumption in one line and continues; explain also gives the reasoning and names which rule or threshold fired.
